melder.nexus.rift.rift_gate.rift_gate.label: rift_gate
melder.nexus.rift.rift_gate.rift_gate.role: The admission and drain gate of the AR layer, sibling to CreationGate for conduits and LoadGate for crystallizer loads; reversible blocking for refresh, one-way close for removal and shutdown, one ticket per thread inside.

melder.nexus.rift.rift_gate.rift_gate.Ri.label: RiftGateDrainTimeoutError
melder.nexus.rift.rift_gate.rift_gate.Ri.role: The Rift gate's drain-timeout error: a RuntimeError carrying how many threads other than the draining caller were still inside.
responsibilities: lets Nexus.remove_rift and Nexus.cleanup tell a drain timeout apart from the gate's other RuntimeErrors
keeps the drain's message, Timeout waiting for rift tickets to drain., so callers catching RuntimeError keep working
carries threads_inside, never counting the draining caller

melder.nexus.rift.rift_gate.rift_gate._R.label: _RiftGateHolder
melder.nexus.rift.rift_gate.rift_gate._R.role: One thread's ticket depth on one RiftGate: a threading.local the gate owns.
responsibilities: counts the calling thread's unreleased admit_ticket and register_ticket calls on its gate, read and written by that thread only
marks the thread as inside: a non-zero depth lets re-entry pass a disabled or closed gate and lets a drain skip the caller's own ticket

melder.nexus.rift.rift_gate.rift_gate.Ri.label: RiftGate
melder.nexus.rift.rift_gate.rift_gate.Ri.role: Rift-scoped admission and drain gate holding one ticket per thread inside.
responsibilities: blocks or admits Rift-scoped work: parks a newcomer while disabled in wait mode, refuses it in raise mode or once terminally closed
holds one ticket per thread inside, a thread-local depth (_RiftGateHolder) counting that thread's nested admissions
admits a thread that already holds a ticket again at once whatever its state, so an ACL refresh or a removal waiting for that thread lets it finish and leave

closes terminally (close_terminally) and drains (wait_until_free, close_and_wait_until_free) without waiting for the caller's own ticket, raising RiftGateDrainTimeoutError when other threads outstay the timeout
treats a ticket released after cleanup as a no-op, its cleanup having cleared every ticket

edges_authored.why: The gate creates its per-thread holder at construction and deletes it at cleanup; a thread's depth there is how the gate knows the thread is already inside.
